heading: Choose Elixir when the operating system needs to be built
body:
Choose Elixir’s operations consulting when your team needs a workflow, documented handoffs, role ownership and a weekly operating rhythm installed. Bring a recent missed handoff or delayed job so the conversation starts with observable work.

We can map the process, define responsibilities and work alongside the team during implementation. If your primary need is personal reflection or leadership habits, compare a coaching engagement on its own terms.

Elixir engagements start at $5,000 per month, with the final fee and deliverables agreed by scope. Review the service · See the implementation process · Discuss your operating problem.

heading: Use Elixir to install a defined system with an internal owner
body:
Consider Elixir when you need outside implementation help for a specific operating problem and can name the person who will own the result internally. A project can address the process, measures and management rhythm while your team retains day-to-day responsibility.

Before choosing outside support, identify which decisions require a permanent employee and which changes can be delivered through a scoped engagement. Request a handover plan that covers documentation, training and the first review cycle.

heading: Choose Elixir when CRM adoption depends on the sales process
body:
Elixir is a useful option when your CRM problem involves stage definitions, lead ownership, follow-up responsibilities and management reporting as well as software setup. Our sales-systems work connects those operating decisions to how the team uses the tools.

Bring a sample deal that stalled. Ask us to trace the handoff, agree what each stage means and define how you will check adoption. Compare the proposed scope with the vendor’s written onboarding deliverables before buying overlapping work.

heading: Choose Elixir when the workflow and its adoption both need attention
body:
Consider Elixir when documenting the current process would preserve a problem rather than solve it. Our operations work includes mapping the actual workflow, clarifying handoffs and responsibilities, and developing procedures around the agreed way of working.

Start with one recurring process and an internal owner. Ask for a pilot with real jobs, a record of changes and an agreed handover. The value is a process your team can run and review, not the number of pages produced.
